\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[a4paper,margin=2cm]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\begin{document}
\section*{Leader color and declaration scope}
\begingroup
\color{blue}
\begin{dirtreex}[dotfill color=red,
  dotfill command={\bfseries\dotfill}]
  \verbdir|project_$|{blue root comment}{
    \verbfile|main_app.py|{blue file comment}
    \verbarchive|release_1.zip|{blue archive comment}{
      \file{README.md}{blue first line\\blue second line}
    }
  }
\end{dirtreex}
\begin{dirtreex}
  \dir{defaults}{blue dotted leaders restored}{
    \file{plain.txt}{blue normal-weight comment}
  }
\end{dirtreex}
\endgroup
Black text after both trees.

\section*{Blank leaders and empty comments}
\begin{dirtreex}[dotfill command=\hfill]
  \archive{blank.zip}{right-aligned comment}{
    \file{empty.txt}{}
    \file{lines.txt}{first line\\second line}
  }
\end{dirtreex}
\begin{dirtreex}[dotfill command={%
  \PackageError{issue5-check}{Leader ran for an empty comment}{}}]
  \dir{empty comments}{}{\file{empty.txt}{}}
\end{dirtreex}

\section*{Natural wrapping in a narrow tree}
\begin{minipage}{0.55\linewidth}
\begin{dirtreex}[dotfill color=teal, dotfill command=\hrulefill]
  \dir{root}{short comment}{
    \file{long.txt}{This comment is deliberately long enough to wrap
      naturally across several lines in this narrow tree.}
  }
\end{dirtreex}
\end{minipage}

\section*{Custom pattern in a larger font}
\begin{dirtreex}[fontsize=\large, dotfill color=purple,
  dotfill command={\cleaders\hbox to 0.8em{%
    \hss\rule[0.4ex]{0.4em}{0.4pt}\hss}\hfill\kern0pt}]
  \dir{large}{larger pattern}{\file{one.txt}{larger text}}
\end{dirtreex}
